title: Postgraduate Java assignment with AI-generated summative feedback
summary: Postgraduate students complete a compulsory end-of-course Java assignment worth 60% of the module. Lecturers grade the work with a rubric, then AutoFeed uses the marks and comments to generate a second feedback script with ChatGPT 3.5 for human review.

sources.title: The use of ChatGPT to generate Summative Feedback in Programming Assessments that is Consistent, Prompt, without Bias and Scalable
sources.evidence_quote: The normal marking and feedback process for the end-of-course assessment, weighted at 60% was carried out as per tradition ... in parallel the course lecturers provided an alternative feedback analysis generated via ChatGPT.

assessment.summary: Complete the end-of-course Java programming assignment and receive human-authored and AI-drafted summative feedback.
student_actions: Submit a complex Java programming assignment.
Review two feedback scripts and report views on them.

student_role.description: AutoFeed drafts narrative feedback after lecturers complete grading.

grading.method: Human markers applied a calibrated rubric; lecturers checked and amended AI-generated narrative feedback.

human_validation.description: Lecturers checked every generated response; 15-20% required amendment.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
